messages.subject: BioGeoBEARS Beginner Guide
parts:
Dear Nick and All,
I am a Botany graduate from University of Chittagong, Bangladesh. As a prospective student, I recently started a self paced biogeographic analysis project using BioGeoBEARS. I got the .tree file basic guidelines from Francis J Nge. and .geog file generated.

I am wondering if anyone who is at their first stage with BioGeoBEARS with whom I can contact and talk about the standard script, hands on training, BSM analysis criteria.

I appreciate your effort.

Sincerely,
Mohammad Jorid
